_comment: The house model. Rooms are zones; edges are doors (the movement graph - you can only walk through doors). Floors come from each room's floor field, so 'which floor am I on' is a table lookup, never a GPS guess. The host can rename rooms and edit tasks from the in-game Setup screen; saving writes this file back. Beacon = an ESP32 whose advertised name is HB-<room id>; cal is an optional dBm offset if a beacon sits oddly far from its room.
_edges: Doors. land2-land1 and land1-land0 are the stairs; every room hangs off a landing. Hallways exist only as these landings - that is what makes an ambush at the bottom of the stairs possible.
_levels: Levels = which floors are in play. Pick one at Start. Whole house is the classic.
_tasks: Chores, honestly done, in the room listed. Each player gets 4 at random from the rooms of the chosen level. The hold button only counts while the server believes you are in that room.
